claim: The moving geometry of the actual reduced 9x9 matrices B(s) is effectively two-dimensional.
evidence: Direct PCA of flattened 81-dimensional B(s) samples; PC1+PC2 cumulative variance is 0.9999999922777 at Q=522.25 and 0.9999986108182 at Q=550.
caution: Established for the two tested Q values and the chosen reduced coordinates.

claim: One P_line interval acts as an approximately antipodal half-turn in the centered active matrix plane.
evidence: Median antipodal cosines exceed 0.999991; fitted active-plane maps have determinant +1, trace near -2, and angles 180.284 and 180.322 degrees.
caution: Approximate, not exact; residuals are phase-dependent.

claim: The active matrix geometry returns after approximately 2 P_line.
evidence: Two-stroke return cosines exceed 0.999936 and the full-return tests passed for both Q values.
caution: The centered 2P residual is larger than the antipodal P residual but remains within the audit threshold.

claim: The dominant tangent orientation reverses at P_line and returns at 2 P_line.
evidence: Median signed returns are approximately -0.999987/+0.999948 at Q=522.25 and -0.999978/+0.999932 at Q=550.
caution: Statement applies to the extracted dominant recurrent tangent line.

claim: The two-stroke matrix motion is overwhelmingly first-harmonic.
evidence: Median fundamental energy fractions are 0.9999941225 and 0.9999901672; even-harmonic fractions are 4.21e-6 and 7.43e-6.
caution: Small higher harmonics and numerical differentiation effects remain.

claim: A constant planar generator produces approximately -I over P_line and I over 2 P_line.
evidence: Normalized J satisfies J^2 + I at 9.61e-17 and 2.38e-16; exp(PG) errors are 9.18e-5 and 8.54e-5.
caution: The global derivative-fit residual is about 3.2% to 3.6%, so the generator is an excellent reduced model rather than an exact identity.

claim: The measured generator frequency agrees with pi/P_line.
evidence: Relative errors are 2.620e-5 at Q=522.25 and 2.417e-5 at Q=550.
caution: Measured in the support-rotation coordinate s.

claim: The dominant rocking anatomy is the reciprocal delta v2 / delta omega2 coupling pair.
evidence: These two entries tie for the maximum fundamental amplitude in both tested cases.
caution: Dominant modal anatomy is not by itself a proof of unique causal origin.

claim: The normalized coupling hierarchy is nearly preserved while the strongest absolute amplitude grows strongly from Q=522.25 to Q=550.
evidence: Maximum fundamental amplitudes are 1.915387e-3 and 2.172974e-2, a ratio of about 11.34.
caution: Only two Q values are compared; no global scaling law is claimed.

claim: A physically closed P_line coefficient loop supporting a Möbius bundle is not currently established.
evidence: Direct centered B(s) geometry shows an antipodal half-cycle and closure at approximately 2 P_line.
caution: A Möbius quotient interpretation remains possible only if the antipodal identification is independently proved to be an exact dynamical symmetry.

claim: The antipodal map R -> -R is an exact dynamical symmetry defining a quotient cycle.
evidence: Suggested by the stable near-half-turn geometry at two Q values.
caution: Requires an explicit state-space symmetry or invariant quotient proof.

claim: The same continuous generator persists over a broad Q interval with a predictable amplitude law.
evidence: The normalized anatomy is similar at Q=522.25 and Q=550.
caution: Requires intermediate-Q and broader parameter tests.
